''Ervum tetraspermum'' L. }} '''''Vicia tetrasperma''''' ([[synonym (taxonomy)|syn.]] '''''Ervum tetraspermum''''')Clive Stace, ''New Flora of the British Isles'', 4th edition 2019, p 171 the '''smooth tare''', '''smooth vetch''', '''lentil vetch''' or '''sparrow vetch''', is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the bean family Fabaceae. ==Description== ''Vicia tetrasperma'' is an [[annual plant]] growing up to {{Convert|60|cm|in|abbr=on}} tall. The leaflets are {{Convert|10|to|20|mm|in|abbr=on}} and are in four to six pairs, the leaf ending with a simple tendril. The pale blue flowers are in racemes of one or two flowers, each about {{Convert|4|mm|in|abbr=on}} long. Four seeds are produced in a pod {{Convert|12|to|15|mm|in|abbr=on}} long.Clapham, A.R., Tutin, T.G. and Warburg, E.F. 1968. ''Excursion Flora of the British Isles''. Cambridge University Press. {{ISBN|0 521 04656 4}} The pod is [[Dehiscence (botany)|dehiscent]]. ==Distribution== This vetch is native to Europe, Asia, and North Africa, and it can be found on other continents as an [[introduced species]]. It can be invasive.{{Cite web|url=https://gobotany.nativeplanttrust.org/species/vicia/tetrasperma/|title = Vicia tetrasperma (Four-seeded vetch): Go Botany}} ==Habitat== Grassy places, local. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== {{Commons|Vicia tetrasperma}} *[http://ucjeps.berkeley.edu/cgi-bin/get_JM_treatment.pl?3691,4296,4312 Jepson Manual Treatment] *[https://plants.usda.gov/java/profile?symbol=VITE USDA Plants Profile] *{{GRIN}} *[http://biology.burke.washington.edu/herbarium/imagecollection.php?Genus=Vicia&Species=tetrasperma Washington Burke Museum] *[http://www.missouriplants.com/Bluealt/Vicia_tetrasperma_page.html Missouri Plants Photo Profile] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110108005936/http://www.missouriplants.com/Bluealt/Vicia_tetrasperma_page.html |date=2011-01-08 }} *[http://www.agroatlas.ru/en/content/weeds/Vicia_tetrasperma/ AgroAtlas Economic Plants] *[http://calphotos.berkeley.edu/cgi/img_query?query_src=photos_index&where-taxon=Vicia+tetrasperma Photo gallery] {{Taxonbar|from=Q157911}} [[Category:Vicia|tetrasperm]] [[Category:Flora of Europe]] [[Category:Flora of North Africa]] [[Category:Flora of temperate Asia]] {{fabeae-stub}}
